# Overview

The publicly available Xenium dataset of Pauli *et al.* (ref. 21; panel 1,
4 control arteries and 12 carotid plaques) was used to study where in the
plaque the PF4- and TGF-β-responsive EC programmes defined in notebook 03 are
expressed.

| Step | Section | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Cell types per sample | 1 | Fig. S10 |
| PF4 / TGF-β module scores | 2 | |
| Lumen boundary, distance to lumen, luminal-adjacent ECs | 3 | Fig. S11-S12, Fig. 6A |
| Spatial module-score maps | 4 | Fig. 6B, Fig. S13-S14 |
| Cell-level comparison per sample | 5 | Fig. S15-S16 |
| Sample-level paired comparison | 6 | Fig. 6C |

# 2. PF4 and TGF-β module scores

Only responsive genes present in the Xenium panel can be used: 14 PF4-responsive
genes (PF4 vs control, FDR < 0.05, log2FC > 0.25) and 26 TGF-β-responsive genes
(TGF-β vs PF4, FDR < 0.05, log2FC > 0.25). Per patient, area-normalised
expression of each gene was z-scored across all cells; the module score of a
cell is the mean z-score across the genes in the set.

```{r module-scores}
module_score <- function(sce, genes) {
  ensg <- rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$HGNC %in% genes]
  message(length(ensg), " genes found in the panel: ", paste(rowData(sce)[ensg, "HGNC"], collapse = ", "))
  expr <- assays(sce)$norm_by_area[ensg, , drop = FALSE]
  score <- rep(NA_real_, ncol(sce))
  for (pat in unique(sce$patient)) {
    cells <- which(sce$patient == pat)
    z <- t(scale(t(as.matrix(expr[, cells, drop = FALSE]))))
    score[cells] <- colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  score
}

panel1$PF4_score <- module_score(panel1, gene_sets$PF4_up_vs_control)    # 14 genes
panel1$TGF_score <- module_score(panel1, gene_sets$TGF_specific_vs_PF4)  # 26 genes
```

# 3. Lumen boundary and luminal-adjacent ECs (Fig. S11-S12, Fig. 6A)

The lumen boundary of each sample was traced manually on the spatial
coordinates (`locator()`), and for every EC the distance to the nearest
boundary point was computed. Because distance distributions differ between
samples, the cut-off was set per sample at the separation in the distance
histogram (Fig. S11). ECs closer than the cut-off are *lumen-adjacent*.

The traced boundaries (`lumen_boundaries.rds`) and per-sample cut-offs
(`lumen_cutoffs.csv`) used in the manuscript are read from `params$lumen_dir`
and are available from the authors upon request. Set `params$redraw_lumen = TRUE`
to repeat the interactive annotation (requires an interactive graphics device;
not run when knitting).

```{r draw-lumen, eval=params$redraw_lumen}
lumen_boundaries <- list()
cutoffs <- data.frame(sample = character(), cutoff = numeric())

for (s in sample_order) {
  repeat {
    idx <- panel1$original_sample == s
    plot(panel1$x_um[idx], panel1$y_um[idx], pch = 16, cex = 0.4, col = "grey80", asp = 1,
         main = paste("Draw lumen boundary:", s))
    points(panel1$x_um[idx & endo_idx], panel1$y_um[idx & endo_idx], pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = "purple")
    message("Draw the lumen boundary; press Esc / right-click to finish")
    boundary <- locator(type = "l")
    if (is.null(boundary)) break
    boundary <- cbind(boundary$x, boundary$y)

    d <- nn2(boundary, cbind(panel1$x_um[idx & endo_idx], panel1$y_um[idx & endo_idx]), k = 1)$nn.dists[, 1]
    hist(d, breaks = 50, main = paste("Distance to lumen:", s), xlab = "Distance to lumen boundary (µm)")
    cutoff <- as.numeric(readline(paste0("Lumen cut-off for ", s, " (µm): ")))
    if (tolower(readline("Redo this sample? (y/n): ")) != "y") {
      lumen_boundaries[[s]] <- boundary
      cutoffs <- rbind(cutoffs, data.frame(sample = s, cutoff = cutoff))
      break
    }
  }
}
dir.create(params$lumen_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(lumen_boundaries, file.path(params$lumen_dir, "lumen_boundaries.rds"))
write.csv(cutoffs, file.path(params$lumen_dir, "lumen_cutoffs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r classify-ecs}
lumen_boundaries <- readRDS(file.path(params$lumen_dir, "lumen_boundaries.rds"))
cutoffs <- read.csv(file.path(params$lumen_dir, "lumen_cutoffs.csv"))
cutoffs

panel1$dist_to_lumen <- NA_real_
panel1$lumen_cutoff  <- NA_real_
panel1$luminal_EC    <- FALSE
for (s in names(lumen_boundaries)) {
  ec_idx <- panel1$original_sample == s & endo_idx
  d <- nn2(lumen_boundaries[[s]], cbind(panel1$x_um[ec_idx], panel1$y_um[ec_idx]), k = 1)$nn.dists[, 1]
  cut <- cutoffs$cutoff[cutoffs$sample == s]
  panel1$dist_to_lumen[ec_idx] <- d
  panel1$lumen_cutoff[ec_idx]  <- cut
  panel1$luminal_EC[ec_idx]    <- d < cut
}

ec_table <- data.frame(Sample = panel1$original_sample, Luminal = panel1$luminal_EC)[endo_idx, ]
table(ec_table$Sample, ec_table$Luminal)
```

## Fig. S11 - Distance-to-lumen histograms with per-sample cut-offs

```{r figS11}
breaks <- seq(0, ceiling(max(panel1$dist_to_lumen, na.rm = TRUE)) + 2, by = 2)
y_max <- ceiling(1.1 * max(sapply(sample_order, function(s) {
  d <- na.omit(panel1$dist_to_lumen[panel1$original_sample == s & endo_idx])
  if (length(d)) max(hist(d, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts) else 0
})))

png(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS11_lumen_distance_histograms.png"), width = 5000, height = 5000, res = 600)
par(mfrow = c(4, 4), mar = c(3, 3.2, 2.2, 1), mgp = c(1.8, 0.6, 0), tcl = -0.25, bty = "l", las = 1)
for (s in sample_order) {
  idx <- panel1$original_sample == s & endo_idx
  hist(na.omit(panel1$dist_to_lumen[idx]), breaks = breaks, col = "grey75", border = "white",
       main = sample_labels[s], xlab = "Distance to lumen boundary (µm)", ylab = "Number of ECs",
       xlim = range(breaks), ylim = c(0, y_max), cex.lab = 0.9, cex.axis = 0.8)
  cut <- cutoffs$cutoff[cutoffs$sample == s]
  if (length(cut) == 1) {
    abline(v = cut, lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    text(cut, y_max * 0.92, paste0("Cutoff = ", cut, " µm"), pos = 4, cex = 0.75)
  }
}
dev.off()
```

## Fig. S12 and Fig. 6A - Lumen-adjacent vs non-lumen-adjacent ECs

```{r figS12-6a}
plot_luminal <- function(s, cex_bg = 0.12, cex_ec = 0.45) {
  idx <- panel1$original_sample == s
  ec_idx <- idx & endo_idx
  plot(panel1$x_um[idx], -panel1$y_um[idx], pch = 16, cex = cex_bg, col = "grey90", asp = 1,
       axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", main = sample_labels[s], cex.main = 0.9)
  points(panel1$x_um[ec_idx & !panel1$luminal_EC], -panel1$y_um[ec_idx & !panel1$luminal_EC],
         pch = 16, cex = cex_ec, col = col_location[["Non-lumen-adjacent ECs"]])
  points(panel1$x_um[ec_idx & panel1$luminal_EC], -panel1$y_um[ec_idx & panel1$luminal_EC],
         pch = 16, cex = cex_ec, col = col_location[["Lumen-adjacent ECs"]])
  if (s %in% names(lumen_boundaries)) {
    lines(lumen_boundaries[[s]][, 1], -lumen_boundaries[[s]][, 2], col = "black", lwd = 1)
  }
}
luminal_legend <- function() {
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); plot.new()
  legend("center", legend = c(names(col_location), "Lumen boundary"),
         col = c(col_location, "black"), pch = c(16, 16, NA), lty = c(NA, NA, 1),
         pt.cex = 1.5, cex = 0.9, bty = "n", horiz = TRUE, xpd = TRUE)
}

png(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS12_luminal_EC_classification.png"), width = 4000, height = 4300, res = 600)
layout(matrix(c(1:16, rep(17, 4)), nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(rep(1, 4), 0.22))
par(mar = c(0.8, 0.8, 2, 0.8), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
for (s in sample_order) plot_luminal(s)
luminal_legend()
dev.off()

for (s in c("Panel1_P11_Pl", "Panel1_P12_Pl")) {
  png(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("Fig6A_luminal_EC_", gsub(" ", "_", sample_labels[s]), ".png")),
      width = 4000, height = 4300, res = 600)
  layout(matrix(1:2, nrow = 2), heights = c(1, 0.15))
  par(mar = c(0.8, 0.8, 2, 0.8), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
  plot_luminal(s, cex_bg = 1, cex_ec = 1.5)
```

# 4. Spatial maps of module scores (Fig. 6B, Fig. S13-S14)

For visualisation only, the top 1% highest-scoring ECs per sample were removed
to limit the influence of extreme values on the colour scale. All statistical
tests (sections 5-6) use the complete data.

```{r score-scales}
score_scales <- list(
  PF4_score = list(limits = c(-0.5, 2.5), breaks = c(-0.5, -0.2, 0, 0.5, 1.2, 2.5), label = "PF4 score"),
  TGF_score = list(limits = c(-0.5, 1.2), breaks = c(-0.5, -0.3, 0, 0.4, 0.9, 1.2), label = "TGF-β score"))
score_cols <- c("#2166AC", "#67A9CF", "lightyellow", "#FDD835", "#F16913", "#B30000")

trim_top_ecs <- function(sce, score, q = 0.99) {
  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(sce)) %>%
    mutate(cell_id = colnames(sce), is_EC = final_low_level_celltype %in% c("EC_1", "EC_2"))
  keep <- meta %>% group_by(original_sample) %>%
    mutate(cut = quantile(.data[[score]][is_EC], q, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(!is_EC | .data[[score]] <= cut) %>% pull(cell_id)
  sce[, keep]
}

plot_score_map <- function(sce, s, score) {
  sc <- score_scales[[score]]
  idx <- sce$original_sample == s
  ec_idx <- idx & sce$final_low_level_celltype %in% c("EC_1", "EC_2")
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(x = sce$x_um[idx], y = -sce$y_um[idx]), colour = "grey90", size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(x = sce$x_um[ec_idx], y = -sce$y_um[ec_idx], colour = sce[[score]][ec_idx]), size = 3.2) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = score_cols, values = rescale(sc$breaks, from = sc$limits),
                           limits = sc$limits, oob = squish, name = sc$label) +
    coord_fixed() + labs(title = sample_labels[s]) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

clean <- list(PF4_score = trim_top_ecs(panel1, "PF4_score"),
              TGF_score = trim_top_ecs(panel1, "TGF_score"))
```

```{r fig6b-s13-s14}
# Fig. 6B - plaque 11 and 12, PF4 score
for (s in c("Panel1_P11_Pl", "Panel1_P12_Pl")) {
  save_fig(plot_score_map(clean$PF4_score, s, "PF4_score"),
           paste0("Fig6B_PF4_score_", gsub("Panel1_", "", s), ".png"), 10, 10, fig_dir, units = "in", dpi = 600)
}

# Fig. S13 (PF4) and S14 (TGF-β) - Control 1-4 and Plaque 1-10
# (plaques 11 and 12 are shown in Fig. 6B)
map_samples <- sample_order[1:14]
for (score in names(score_scales)) {
  maps <- lapply(map_samples, function(s) {
    plot_score_map(clean[[score]], s, score) + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
  })
  save_fig(ggarrange(plotlist = maps, ncol = 4, nrow = 4, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom",
                     legend.grob = get_legend(plot_score_map(clean[[score]], sample_order[1], score))),
           paste0(if (score == "PF4_score") "FigS13" else "FigS14", "_spatial_", score, ".png"),
           16, 16, fig_dir, units = "in")
}
```

# 5. Cell-level comparison per sample (Fig. S15-S16)

Within each sample, scores of lumen-adjacent and non-lumen-adjacent ECs were
compared with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test on all ECs; box plots show the trimmed
data (section 4).

```{r figS15-16}
score_box <- function(s, score) {
  full <- data.frame(Score = panel1[[score]], Luminal = panel1$luminal_EC)[panel1$original_sample == s & endo_idx, ]
  ci <- clean[[score]]
  plot_df <- data.frame(Score = ci[[score]], Luminal = ci$luminal_EC)[
    ci$original_sample == s & ci$final_low_level_celltype %in% c("EC_1", "EC_2"), ]
  lab <- function(x) factor(ifelse(x, "Lumen-adjacent ECs", "Non-lumen-adjacent ECs"), levels = names(col_location))
  full$Location <- lab(full$Luminal); plot_df$Location <- lab(plot_df$Luminal)

  if (length(unique(full$Location)) < 2) return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = sample_labels[s]))
  p <- wilcox.test(Score ~ Location, data = full)$p.value
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(Location, Score, fill = Location)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(plot_df$Score, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08,
             label = paste0("p = ", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)), size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_location) +
    labs(x = "", y = score_scales[[score]]$label, title = sample_labels[s]) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 25, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
}

for (score in names(score_scales)) {
  save_fig(ggarrange(plotlist = lapply(sample_order, score_box, score = score), ncol = 4, nrow = 4, align = "hv"),
           paste0(if (score == "PF4_score") "FigS15" else "FigS16", "_boxplots_", score, "_per_sample.png"),
           22, 25, fig_dir, units = "in", dpi = 600)
}
```

# 6. Sample-level paired comparison (Fig. 6C)

To account for differences in the number of ECs per sample, the median score of
lumen-adjacent and non-lumen-adjacent ECs was calculated per sample and the two
were compared with a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (sample = unit of
observation), separately for control arteries (n = 4) and plaques (n = 12).

```{r fig6c, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
df_sample <- data.frame(Sample = as.character(panel1$original_sample), PF4 = panel1$PF4_score,
                        TGF = panel1$TGF_score, Luminal = panel1$luminal_EC)[endo_idx, ] %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("_Ctrl$", Sample), "Control", "Plaque"),
         Location = factor(ifelse(Luminal, "Lumen-adjacent ECs", "Non-lumen-adjacent ECs"),
                           levels = names(col_location))) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Location) %>%
  summarise(PF4 = median(PF4, na.rm = TRUE), TGF = median(TGF, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(PF4, TGF), names_to = "Module", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Panel = factor(paste(Group, Module),
                        levels = c("Plaque PF4", "Plaque TGF", "Control PF4", "Control TGF")))

p_values <- df_sample %>%
  group_by(Panel) %>%
  summarise(p_value = {
    w <- pivot_wider(pick(Sample, Location, Score), names_from = Location, values_from = Score) %>% drop_na()
    wilcox.test(w$`Lumen-adjacent ECs`, w$`Non-lumen-adjacent ECs`, paired = TRUE)$p.value
  }, y = max(Score, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_label = paste0("p = ", format.pval(p_value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)))
p_values

p6c <- ggplot(df_sample, aes(Location, Score, fill = Location)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Sample), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.04, size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = p_values, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = p_label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 8) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Panel, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(Panel = c("Plaque PF4" = "Plaque PF4", "Plaque TGF" = "Plaque TGF-β",
                                           "Control PF4" = "Control PF4", "Control TGF" = "Control TGF-β"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_location) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Sample-level median score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8))
save_fig(p6c, "Fig6C_sample_level_PF4_TGF_luminal.png", 18, 8, fig_dir, units = "in", dpi = 600)
p6c
```
